description: Official and institutional documents the planner's assistant retrieves from (RAG). Each entry is downloaded and converted to plain text by datasets/scripts/fetch_knowledge.py. The text itself is not committed (some sources are copyrighted); only this list is.

sources.title: MIDH Operational Guidelines 2025 (guidelines dated 31.12.2024)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Horticulture Division (hosted by National Horticulture Board)
sources.note: Scheme rules, pattern of assistance and cost norms for protected cultivation. Later MoA&FW letters can modify it; the 2025-08-12 letter in the curated facts sets the 4000 sq m limit.

sources.title: NHB Cost Norms and Pattern of Assistance (Appendix-1)
sources.note: Undated document; treat the rates as the current published norms. States may use their own rates.

sources.title: NHB Scheme-1 Operational Guidelines: Development of Commercial Horticulture
sources.note: Older guidelines. Its area thresholds (2500 sq m, 1000 sq m in the North East) were replaced by the MoA&FW letter of 2025-08-12 (4000 sq m); prefer the current facts where they differ.

sources.title: Green Houses / Polyhouses: technical specifications for naturally ventilated poly house
sources.publisher: Department of Horticulture, Government of Telangana
sources.note: State specification used for subsidy-eligible structures; other states may differ.

sources.title: Protected Cultivation (Job Role) Textbook for Class XI, Agriculture sector
sources.publisher: PSS Central Institute of Vocational Education, NCERT
sources.note: Copyright NCERT 2018. Used here only to answer questions with attribution.

sources.title: IPM Schedule for Vegetables (insect and disease management, including polyhouse packages)
sources.publisher: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Agritech Portal (national technical bulletin)
sources.note: Chemical recommendations change over time and by label; confirm with the state agriculture department.

sources.title: Tomato: protected cultivation
sources.publisher: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Agritech Portal

sources.title: Cucumber: crop production guide
sources.publisher: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Agritech Portal

sources.title: Capsicum: crop production guide
sources.publisher: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Agritech Portal

sources.title: Gerbera: crop production guide
sources.publisher: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Agritech Portal

sources.title: Strawberry: package of practices
sources.publisher: Krishi Vigyan Kendra Chirang, Assam Agricultural University
sources.note: Open-field oriented, from Assam; use with care for polyhouse planning elsewhere.

gaps: No official lettuce or hydroponic NFT guide was found; the assistant must say so rather than guess.
NHB Technical Standard NHB-PH-Type 02-2011 (design loads) could not be downloaded from nhb.gov.in.
State-specific subsidy rates other than Telangana are not included.
